description: This file is a Python module implementing data access and business logic for notes and tags in a note-taking backend. It defines functions to create, retrieve, update, delete, and list notes and tags, often involving database operations with SQLAlchemy's async interface. It also includes internal helper functions for managing tags and note-tag relationships.

methods.name: List[TagOut] _fetch_tags_for_note(session: AsyncSession, note_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches tags associated with a specific note.

methods.name: NoteOut _note_row_to_out(note_row: Dict[str, Any], tags: List[TagOut])
methods.description: Converts a note database row and tags into a NoteOut schema.

methods.name: TagOut create_tag(session: AsyncSession, payload: TagCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new tag; raises an exception if the tag name already exists.

methods.name: List[TagOut] list_tags(session: AsyncSession, q: Optional[str])
methods.description: Lists tags, optionally filtered by a query string.

methods.name: TagOut get_tag(session: AsyncSession, tag_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a tag by its ID.

methods.name: TagOut update_tag(session: AsyncSession, tag_id: UUID, payload: TagUpdate)
methods.description: Updates a tag's name, handling conflicts and non-existence.

methods.name: None delete_tag(session: AsyncSession, tag_id: UUID)
methods.description: Deletes a tag by its ID.

methods.name: None _ensure_tag_ids_exist(session: AsyncSession, tag_ids: List[UUID])
methods.description: Verifies that a list of tag IDs exists in the database.

methods.name: None _replace_note_tags(session: AsyncSession, note_id: UUID, tag_ids: List[UUID])
methods.description: Replaces all tags associated with a note.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note(session: AsyncSession, payload: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new note, optionally with tags.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note(session: AsyncSession, note_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches a note by ID, including tags.

methods.name: bool _note_exists(session: AsyncSession, note_id: UUID)
methods.description: Checks if a note exists and is not deleted.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note(session: AsyncSession, note_id: UUID, payload: Any)
methods.description: Updates fields of a note and optionally its tags.

methods.name: str _order_by_clause(order: str)
methods.description: Returns SQL order by clause based on order parameter.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] list_notes(session: AsyncSession, query: NoteListQuery)
methods.description: Lists and searches notes with filters and pagination.

methods.name: NoteOut set_note_pinned(session: AsyncSession, note_id: UUID, is_pinned: bool)
methods.description: Pins or unpins a note, setting the pinned timestamp.
